title.en: Tale 6 — Dimna Speaks to the Lion

sentences.ar: راح دمنة عند الأسد وقعد ساكت.
sentences.en: Dimna went to the lion and sat silent.
The lion asked him: what is wrong with you?

sentences.ar: قال دمنة: في إشي بس بخاف أحكيه.
sentences.en: Dimna said: there is something, but I am afraid to say it.

sentences.ar: قال: شتربة بيحكي مع الحيوانات عنك.
sentences.en: He said: Shatraba talks to the animals about you.
And he says he is stronger than you.
The lion was silent a long time and began to think.
